capabilities: Subscribe to RSS feeds via a Markdown feed list file
Filter articles with keyword whitelist and blacklist rules
Read feed articles in a side panel with reading-position memory
Save articles as Markdown notes using a file-name template
disambiguation: Not a feed publisher; it reads external RSS feeds inside Obsidian rather than generating a feed from your notes.
extras: Listing note says the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Documentation is bilingual (English and Chinese) with a built-in user manual; feed data is stored locally under .rss-reader/.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to subscribe to RSS feeds, read them, or turn articles into vault notes, so users must rely on external readers.

relations.evidence: All subscriptions live in a plain-text RSS Feeds.md file you can edit by hand, sync with git/Obsidian Sync

summary: RSS reader that keeps subscriptions in a Markdown file, shows articles in a side panel with keyword filters, and saves them as notes.
